surface.description: null: plain `color`. Or a real material for it from the set library (its colour comes from the material; `color` is unused): cream_marble: warm cream marble with soft veins, polished: luxury, timeless; granite: dark grey speckled granite: luxury, masculine, tech; terrazzo: terrazzo, flecks in warm stone: modern, playful, design; dark_wood: dark reddish-brown wood: warm, crafted, premium; light_wood: light warm wood veneer: natural, Scandinavian, calm; concrete: smooth grey-brown concrete: urban, minimal, raw; stone: rough brown natural rock: outdoors, rugged, organic; sand: fine pale beach sand: summer, sun care, coastal; plaster: warm beige plaster: soft, natural, skincare (a wall); blue_linen: soft blue linen cloth: fresh, calm, home; red_velvet: deep red velvet: luxury, evening, romance
surface.title: Surface

texture.description: an image to cover it with (a path), e.g. from Muse Image
texture.title: Texture

move.description: static: holds; orbit: circles it; dolly: pushes in/out; crane: rises or drops; truck: slides past; reveal: aim pans onto it; zoom: lens only; path: glides through waypoints (points): any route, e.g. low from the side, rising over the top into a close-up
move.title: Move

fill.description: share of the frame's height the product fills; 0.45 wide, 0.6 medium, 0.9 close, over 0.97 crops it (a close-up)
fill.title: Fill

azimuth.description: degrees around: 0 front, 90 its right, -90 its left
azimuth.title: Azimuth

elevation.description: degrees above; low angles (2-8) feel heroic
elevation.title: Elevation

fov_degrees.description: vertical lens angle; 30 is a product lens
fov_degrees.title: Fov Degrees

aperture.description: depth of field, the f-number: the product's front stays sharp and what's behind softens; unset or 0 = all sharp, 2-2.8 a very soft background (close-ups, heroes), 4-5.6 a softened set
aperture.title: Aperture

points.description: path: 2 to 8 waypoints, `at` rising from 0 to 1; the camera glides through them, never swinging past one
points.title: Points

EndCard.description:
The ad's last seconds: the film dissolves into a still card, the
product as photographed, the brand's name and a line under it.

seconds.description: how long it adds after the last shot (its dissolve begins a little before the film ends)
seconds.title: Seconds

name.description: the brand's name as it should read
name.title: Name

tagline.description: a short line under the name, or null
tagline.title: Tagline

background.description: the card's colour: from the brand's palette, calm and solid
background.title: Background

font.description: the name's font, as the titles'
font.title: Font

EndCard.title: EndCard

hdri.description: the light environment around the product: it lights it, shows in its reflections (glass and metal read by it) and, with show_skybox, is the background. By name: studio: a small photo studio: soft, neutral light (the default); studio_bright: a large bright photo studio: clean, even, high key; studio_warm: a studio with warm brown walls: cosy, crafted; fireplace: a room lit by a fire: warm, intimate, evening; golden_hour: open land at sunrise: golden, natural, hopeful; sunset_sky: a blazing orange sunset sky: dramatic, bold; daylight: a clear blue sky with soft clouds: fresh, outdoors; city_night: a city's lights at night: urban, energetic, nightlife (or an HDRI's path under the Studio's assets)
hdri.title: Hdri

use_ibl.description: light and reflect with the light environment (keep on for glass and metal)
use_ibl.title: Use Ibl

show_skybox.description: show the light environment as the background, blurred by sky_blur; needs look.backdrop null (the backdrop's wall hides it)
show_skybox.title: Show Skybox

sky_blur.description: how soft the background environment is: 0.2 recognisable, 0.35 a soft photographic blur, 0.6 only colour and light
sky_blur.title: Sky Blur

painted.description: a background painted for this ad by Muse Image, from this description of a place, its light and colours (e.g. 'a sunlit limestone bathroom, palm leaf shadows, warm morning light'): shown behind the product, blurred by sky_blur, and lighting it, in place of `hdri` (and of the backdrop); for a place the library doesn't have
painted.title: Painted

ambient_strength.description: 0.05 dark and moody, 0.6 bright and airy
ambient_strength.title: Ambient Strength

bloom.description: glow around bright highlights; 0.03 clean, 0.14 dreamy or neon
bloom.title: Bloom

tonemap.description: aces: filmic and contrasty, keeps colours rich; neutral: colours as authored (bright, clean looks); agx: soft, greys colours out (only for a white, grey or black product)
tonemap.title: Tonemap

image.description: path to the label artwork (PNG with transparent corners, or JPG)
image.title: Image

from.description: meters up the product where it starts (default: the template's)
from.title: From

arc.description: degrees it wraps around the front; 360 all the way round
arc.title: Arc

preset.description: rim_dark: luxury, moody; high_key: clean, bright (light backdrop); top_soft: natural, skylight; split: dramatic; neon_dual: bold, energetic; three_point: neutral; overhead_soft: a flat product lying down (its top face lit, its front filled); edge_rim: a dark product (bright rims trace its outline on any set)
preset.title: Preset

turn.description: degrees to turn the whole setup around the product
turn.title: Turn

fade_in.description: seconds over which every light rises from dark at the start (a reveal)
fade_in.title: Fade In

glow.description: a soft pool of light on the wall behind the product: glass lights up in it in the colour of what it holds (a backlit bottle); 1 subtle, 2-3 strong; for glass on a dark set
glow.title: Glow

background.description: linear RGB where nothing is drawn (behind the backdrop's edges)
background.title: Background

backdrop.description: the floor curving up into a wall behind; null: none, the light environment is the background (set environment.show_skybox, which removes the backdrop by itself)

pedestal.description: null: the product stands on the floor

props.description: objects set around the product (none: the product alone)
props.title: Props

Music.description:
The ad's music, synthesized for it: a mood, its tempo and its key. The
cuts land on its beats, so the tempo is the cutting pace too.

mood.description: dark: slow minor pads over a sub drone, a heartbeat pulse; calm: soft major pads and a plucked arpeggio; energetic: four on the floor, claps, a pumping bass and chord stabs; warm: electric-piano chords with tremolo, a soft shaker
mood.title: Mood

bpm.description: its tempo in beats per minute, within the mood's range: dark 60-90, calm 70-110, energetic 100-140, warm 70-105; a beat lasts 60/bpm s, and the cuts land on beats
bpm.title: Bpm

key.description: semitones up (+) or down (-) from the mood's home key: lower is deeper and heavier, higher brighter and lighter
key.title: Key

Music.title: Music

opacity.description: below 1: see-through by fading out (a ghost, not glass; for glass use transmission)
opacity.title: Opacity

transmission.description: glass and clear liquids: 0.9-1 shows the set through it, bent and tinted (then keep opacity unset)
transmission.title: Transmission

ior.description: glass: index of refraction, 1.5 glass, 1.33 water
ior.title: Ior

thickness.description: glass: meters light travels through it (default the part's width: a solid bottle of liquid)
thickness.title: Thickness

attenuation_color.description: glass: the colour light takes on through it, i.e. the liquid's (amber perfume, green oil)
attenuation_color.title: Attenuation Color

attenuation_distance.description: glass: meters of it after which light has fully taken on attenuation_color: 0.05 deep, 0.08 rich, 0.15 pale (under 0.04 a bottle turns nearly black); needed with it
attenuation_distance.title: Attenuation Distance

clearcoat.description: a glossy lacquer over it (lacquered caps, coated labels), 0..1
clearcoat.title: Clearcoat

PathPoint.description: A free path's waypoint: where the camera is at `at` of the shot.

at.description: the share of the shot it's reached at: the first 0, the last 1
at.title: At

azimuth.description: degrees around: 0 front, 90 its right, -90 its left
azimuth.title: Azimuth

fill.description: share of the frame's height it fills (0.45 wide, 0.9 close)
fill.title: Fill

PathPoint.title: PathPoint

width.description: diameter, meters; a little wider than the product
width.title: Width

height.description: meters; the product stands on it
height.title: Height

roughness.description: keep high (0.8+) under rim lights, or its top glares
roughness.title: Roughness

surface.description: null: plain `color`. Or a material (see look.backdrop.surface); a low wide pedestal of one is a slab to stand the product on
surface.title: Surface

template.description: the shape; null with `profile_parts` for a shape traced from a photo
template.title: Template

parts.description: template parts' looks by name: body, cap, lid, collar, bulb
parts.title: Parts

profile_parts.description: the shape as profiles (from the brand analyst), instead of a template
profile_parts.title: Profile Parts

model.description: the product as a 3D model file (.glb: meters, Y up, base at the origin), for shapes that aren't round; instead of a template or profiles (pipeline.studio.models)
model.title: Model

finish.description: a model's finish over its own texture: metallic, roughness, clear coat, glass

ProductMotion.description: The product moving during a shot (it's back at rest at the next cut).

move.description: turn: turns on its own axis and settles facing front by the end (shows the label coming round); float: rises gently, weightless, through the shot; drop: falls onto its stand in the shot's first 40%, then holds still; tilt: leans gently towards the camera and back
move.title: Move

amount.description: turn: degrees it turns (default 45; 360 a full spin; negative the other way); tilt: degrees it leans (default 8); float: how far it rises and drop: how far above it starts, as a share of its height (defaults 0.08 and 0.35)
amount.title: Amount

transmission.title: Transmission

profile.description: [radius, height] in meters, bottom to top

PropPlace.description:
An object from the prop library set beside the product, at its real
size, on the pedestal if it fits there whole, else on the floor.

angle.description: where around the product, in degrees as the camera's azimuth: 0 in front (between it and a camera at azimuth 0), 90 its right, -90 its left, 180 behind
angle.title: Angle

gap.description: the space between it and the product, in product widths (0: touching)
gap.title: Gap

turn.description: degrees it's turned about its vertical
turn.title: Turn

intent.description: what the shot is for, in a sentence: the critic judges it against this
intent.title: Intent

duration.description: seconds; shots run back to back from 0
duration.title: Duration

motion.description: the product moving in this shot; null: it stands still

transition.description: how the ad comes into this shot from the one before: cut (straight in) or dip (a brief fade through black, into the hero only: elsewhere it plays as a cut)
transition.title: Transition
